values.goal: Compile validated ADL v2 language documents through pure resolution, composition and pattern expansion, stable node identity, and canonical lowering into a byte-deterministic ExecutionPlan.
values.required_outcome: An independent adl-compiler crate consumes only the landed typed adl-language boundary, produces canonical ExecutionPlan data or stable diagnostics with no side effects, and proves identical plan bytes and node identities across equivalent inputs, permutations, repeated runs, and clean processes.
declared_scope: typed canonical ExecutionPlan, plan-node, edge, port, provenance, and diagnostic contracts
deterministic reference resolution plus composition and pattern expansion
canonical node, edge, port, metadata, diagnostic, and JSON ordering
golden, negative, replay, permutation, identity-stability, and #5339 fixture-map proof
issue-local lifecycle, design, validation, review, and evidence records
authority_boundary: Issue #5338 owns only adl-v2/crates/adl-compiler and issue-local C-SDLC records
The merged and typed closed_out #5339 adl-language API and fixtures are read-only inputs
The compiler accepts an already parsed and validated document and owns no source parser or language-policy duplication
ExecutionPlan is inert deterministic data; scheduling, retry, joins, resume, failure propagation, runtime ports, and side effects belong to #5340

The crate owns no Runtime v2 or v3, provider or tool IO, records/signing, CLI, selector, C-SDLC, network, filesystem mutation, clock, randomness, environment, credentials, cloud, or database authority
Incumbent ADL source, tests, and fixtures are behavioral evidence only and must not be copied, adapted, imported, or linked
operator_constraints: Use installed typed C-SDLC v2 binaries and semantic card operations only
Never edit, switch, pull, fast-forward, or leave artifacts in root main
Do not use raw gh, AWS, Runtime v2, credentials, or network providers
Keep all canonical #5338 lifecycle, card, design, validation, and implementation artifacts in the dedicated issue worktree
Do not implement product code until #5339 is merged and typed closed_out
Use /Volumes/FastWork for all Rust build output
Run bounded subagent preparation review now and exact-revision code review before publication
Continue automatically through typed review, publication, green CI, authorized merge, post-merge proof, and typed closeout once the dependency gate opens
